newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediobanca 5-yr eurolire bond offer ends early.
newsitem.headline: Mediobanca 5-yr eurolire bond offer ends early.

text.p: The offer of a Mediobanca five-year eurolire bond convertible into ordinary shares in Italian insurer Alleanza Assicurazioni has closed early, the Italian merchant bank said on Wednesday.
Bookbuilding for the Mediobanca International Limited 1997-2002 two percent bond began on Tuesday and had been due to run through Wednesday.
Mediobanca is global coordinator for the placement together with joint lead managers Goldman Sachs International and Paribas.
It said requests had exceeded the amount on offer and the price of the bonds would be fixed this Wednesday evening.
The bonds are exchangeable into 53 million ordinary Alleanza shares held by Assicurazioni Generali, representing 8.7 percent of Alleanza's ordinary share capital.
